# Downloadable Bedrock packs

| File | What |
|------|------|
| **[Vultrom.mcaddon](./Vultrom.mcaddon)** | Both packs — easiest install |
| [Vultrom_BP.mcpack](./Vultrom_BP.mcpack) | Behavior pack only |
| [Vultrom_RP.mcpack](./Vultrom_RP.mcpack) | Resource pack only |

**Install:** download → double-click to import into Minecraft Bedrock → create/edit world → enable **both** packs → play. **No experiments required.**

**Find ore:** `/function vultrom/find_sapphire` (or chat `!findsapphire`).
